description: Make a cinematic short film, music video or story video with Kling 4 the way it works best: beat sheet, a cast and look reference, every key shot made as a still on GPT Image 2.5, then one 30-second Kling 4 reference-to-video take per beat from two to four stills and a short prompt, then cut the usable seconds like live-action takes. Includes the still prompt template ("Image 1 is the man to match exactly…"), the take prompt, dialogue scenes, a fix pass for faces and hands, costs and the varg calls. Use when someone wants a short film, music video, Halloween or holiday film, comedy sketch, trailer or narrative scene made with Kling 4 (kling_v4), asks how to get cinematic Kling 4 results, or says their Kling 4 output looks like AI slop. For prompt rules only use kling-4-prompting; for a single action montage use kling-4-action-montage.
